mapper.sql: id, task_id, task_type, status, priority, input_json, options_json, result_text, finish_reason, provider, model, attempt_count, max_attempts, lease_owner, lease_token, lease_expire_at, last_error_type, last_error_code, last_error_message, input_tokens, output_tokens, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_task WHERE task_id = #{taskId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_task SET status = 'RUNNING', lease_owner = #{runnerId}, lease_token = #{claimToken}, lease_expire_at = #{leaseExpireAt}, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, started_at = COALESCE(started_at, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)), updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY priority DESC, updated_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

UPDATE ai_task SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', result_text = #{resultText}, finish_reason = #{finishReason}, input_tokens = input_tokens + COALESCE(#{inputTokens}, 0), output_tokens = output_tokens + COALESCE(#{outputTokens}, 0), last_error_type = NULL, last_error_code = NULL, last_error_message = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_token = NULL, lease_expire_at = NULL, finished_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND lease_expire_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)

UPDATE ai_task SET status = #{targetStatus}, input_tokens = input_tokens + COALESCE(#{inputTokens}, 0), output_tokens = output_tokens + COALESCE(#{outputTokens}, 0), last_error_type = #{errorType}, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_message = #{errorMessage}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_token = NULL, lease_expire_at = NULL, finished_at = CASE WHEN #{terminal} THEN UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ELSE NULL END, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND lease_expire_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)

UPDATE ai_task SET status = 'CANCELLED', last_error_type = NULL, last_error_code = NULL, last_error_message = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_token = NULL, lease_expire_at = NULL, finished_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE ai_task SET status = 'CANCELLED', last_error_type = NULL, last_error_code = NULL, last_error_message = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_token = NULL, lease_expire_at = NULL, finished_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_token = #{leaseToken}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_task WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_expire_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY lease_expire_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_task SET status = #{targetStatus}, last_error_type = 'TIMEOUT', last_error_code = 'LEASE_EXPIRED', last_error_message = 'Execution lease expired', lease_owner = NULL, lease_token = NULL, lease_expire_at = NULL, finished_at = CASE WHEN #{terminal} THEN UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ELSE NULL END, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND lease_expire_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
